documents.title: Course documents
documents.description: Documents uploaded here are indexed and used to ground tutor and evaluator responses.
documents.accepted: Accepted formats: PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD (max 20 MB).

anamnesis_cases.accepted: Upload a clinical case (PDF, DOCX, TXT or MD, max 20 MB). The model will extract patient persona, diagnosis, symptoms and emotional state for you to review.

editor.title: Review case
editor.description: Review and complete the extracted fields. The title and description are shown to students; the diagnosis and symptoms must NOT appear in them.
editor.section_student_hint: What the student sees in the selection modal. Keep it neutral — do not mention the diagnosis.
editor.field_level_hint: Students below this level can't pick the case.
editor.placeholder_title: e.g. Adult male with acute chest pain
editor.placeholder_description: Two lines describing the scenario without giving away the diagnosis.
editor.placeholder_symptoms:
chest pain
shortness of breath
nausea
editor.symptoms_hint: Each line becomes one symptom in the simulation.

errors.diagnosis_required: Hidden diagnosis is required to publish.
errors.symptoms_required: At least one symptom is required to publish.

radiology_cases.accepted: Upload a radiological image (PNG or JPEG, max 20 MB). The model will analyse it and extract the findings and impression for you to review.

editor.title: Review case
editor.description: Review and complete the extracted fields. The title and level are shown to students; the findings and impression must NOT reveal the diagnosis to them.
editor.field_level_hint: Students below this level can't pick the case.
editor.field_findings_hint: Each line becomes one expected finding in the simulation.
editor.placeholder_title: e.g. Chest X-ray with right basal opacity
editor.placeholder_findings:
right basal opacity
blunting of the costophrenic angle
no pneumothorax
editor.placeholder_impression: Findings compatible with right basal consolidation.

errors.findings_required: At least one finding is required to publish.
